decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line builds directly on the firm's natural skincare formulation know-how, has kept a dedicated page for two years, and the firm can interpret and refine its results in-house, so it fits its absorptive capacity well.

The hyaluronic serum is close to the core facial care range and has been sustained for two years, and the firm's integrated development and small-batch production let it learn from feedback and improve the product rather than drop it.

The cleansing oil appears to succeed the dropped cleansing milk and applies what the firm learned about facial cleansers within its existing oil-based natural formulation knowledge, so it is worth keeping while early results are assessed.
